S0_SEND_STAGE_REQ.description: Phase 1a: Client must send initial StageTreeRequest with root_digest

S1_WAIT_STAGE_RESP.description: Phase 1b: Client must Read() initial StageTreeResponse containing staging_path

S2_STAGED_ACTIVE.description: Phase 2a (Cleanup): Directory is staged; on teardown (~GrpcStagedDirectory), client sends empty StageTreeRequest

S3_CLEANUP_SENT.description: Phase 2b: Client half-closes stream via WritesDone()

S4_WAIT_CLEANUP_ACK.description: Phase 2c: Client MUST Read() the server's second StageTreeResponse acknowledging cleanup completion

S5_CLEANUP_ACKED.description: Phase 2d: Client MUST call Finish() to harvest final gRPC Status

S6_FINISHED.description: Terminal state: 2-phase StageTree protocol cleanly completed
